types.name: Antonym of a given word
types.description: A single word stands alone after the instruction (often in capitals or bold), e.g. 'Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. LIBERTY', and the four options are single words.

types.name: Antonym of a word in a sentence
types.description: A full sentence is given with one word underlined, bold or italicised, and the question asks for the antonym (opposite) of that word.

types.name: Fill the blank with an antonym
types.description: A sentence has a blank followed by a word in brackets, e.g. 'Sheila ______ (failed) all her classes', and the question asks for the antonym of the bracketed word that fits the blank.

types.name: Find the antonym inside the sentence
types.description: A word is named in the question (e.g. 'the ANTONYM of the word Unsure from the given sentence') and the four options are words taken from the sentence itself.
